title: The Nonlinearity Tax
description: Under secure two-party inference, a transformer's cost is eaten by Softmax and GELU, not the matrix multiplies. Stacked per-operation communication and interaction rounds for one BERT-base block across Iron, BumbleBee, and Nimbus — the nonlinear activations are 80–95% of the bill.
